Google Maps 'Battlehill RV Park', 2443 Pueblo Rd, Galva (2026-11-05): 4.8 from 53 reviews, phone (620) 654-7474, website battlehillrvpark.com. RV Life park 262227: 9.66/10 from 10, price_level 2; camper reviews 6/2025 and 8/2026 '$25 USD' motorhome pull-throughs, 'there is a 3+mile gravel road to get here'.

note: Private park next to McPherson State Fishing Lake and the Maxwell Wildlife Refuge (bison and elk), reached by a gravel road of 3+ miles that gets dusty or muddy. --Claude
summary: Operator: 31 FHU 30/50-amp sites, open all year, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi, $25/day ($150/wk, $400/mo); Campspot sells half the sites at $28 (all six test dates). Google 4.8/53. Fees re-sourced and dated (25-28), pull-through + 75-ft max, wifi, booking platform/url/note added. Not waterfront kept (lake ~150-250 m east across road and trees).
flags: PRICE GATE: $25 by phone / $28 on Campspot (read 2026-11-05, Nov 2026-Jun 2027) - under US$50. No gateway check needed.
PRESENCE: working site + phone 620-654-7474 (matches) + Google 4.8 from 53 reviews; RV Life 9.66 from 10.

LONG-STAY TESTS: pass on what I read - posted nightly rate, transient 1-night online bookings on every test date, RV Life reviews by passing motorhomes (2025-2026). The $150/week and $400/month rates are cheap enough to draw monthly stays; nothing says seasonal or residential.
DISCOUNTS: good_sam and military (Good Sam directory, derived) left alone; the operator site mentions neither.
WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the loops sit ~150-250 m west of McPherson State Fishing Lake's shore, with the park road and a tree belt between.

PIN: stored 38.4781,-97.4742 is the entrance at the section road, ~240 m north of the loops' centre (~38.4760,-97.4736); optional move. Campspot's own pin (38.4785,-97.4906) is ~1.4 km west in open prairie - wrong, ignore it.
WEBSITE https://www.battlehillrvpark.com fine. SAND: none. ACCESS: 3+ miles of gravel road (RV Life camper, 6/2025).
